Tupolev Tu-160 'Blackjack' - Russian Air Force 121st Guards TBAP (Ilya Muromets, RF-94105)

Author: Skylogue Curators • Tooling Lineage: Herpa 1:200 Shared Tooling (OEM Heritage)

Red 06 (RF-94105 (c/n 84105)) Original Collector Photography

Real Aircraft Background & The Modernized Tu-160M

The Tupolev Tu-160 (NATO reporting name: Blackjack, known to Russian aircrews as the White Swan or Bely Lebed) remains the largest and heaviest supersonic military aircraft, as well as the fastest operational heavy bomber ever constructed.

Airframe RF-94105 (Bort Red 06), officially christened Ilya Muromets after the legendary Kievan Rus hero and the pioneering WWI Sikorsky heavy bomber, holds an exceptional place in contemporary aviation history. It served as the lead prototype airframe for the comprehensive Tu-160M modernization program, undergoing structural retrofits, next-generation digital glass cockpits, upgraded NVG compatibility, and upgraded Kuznetsov NK-32-02 powerplants.

In February 2024, RF-94105 drew global media attention when Russian President Vladimir Putin personally took the co-pilot's seat during a high-profile 30-minute demonstration flight from Kazan Aviation Plant, cementing this specific airframe as a cornerstone of modern strategic deterrence.

The WLTK vs. Herpa Mold Lineage Secret

Within 1:200 scale military diecast circles, WLTK represents one of the industry's best-kept insider secrets:

  1. Shared Tooling: WLTK's 1:200 Tu-160 mold is 100% identical to the renowned Herpa Wings 1:200 diecast mold. Industry analysis strongly indicates that WLTK operates as the primary OEM foundry that manufactured Herpa's 1:200 strategic heavy line (including the Rockwell B-1B Lancer, Northrop B-2 Spirit, Boeing B-52 Stratofortress, and Tupolev Tu-95MS Bear).
  2. Superior Finish & Discontinued Liveries: While Herpa produced limited runs of the Tu-160 that now command astronomical secondary market prices ($300+ on eBay), WLTK offers collectors access to modern upgraded liveries with pristine anti-flash white paint, exquisite stenciling around the variable-geometry wing hinges, and razor-sharp cockpit windscreen framing.
  3. Variable Geometry Mechanism: The swing-wing mechanics operate smoothly with authentic wing-root sweep angles (20° takeoff, 35° cruise, and 65° high-speed dash).
